title: Ahmedabad pols explained: why some house fronts were secret escape routes
description:
A pol is a gated residential lane in old Ahmedabad, 50 to 100 houses sharing side walls behind a single gate. Many were shaped like small fortresses in the 1700s, during the Mughal and Maratha fights over the city, with a guard room above the gate, rooftops joined house to house and narrow passages, some disguised as house fronts, for escape. The walled city became India's first UNESCO World Heritage City in 2017.

Sources: UNESCO World Heritage Centre (Historic City of Ahmadabad), Live History India (2020), Deccan Herald (2022), Wikipedia. Photos: Kalpit Visavadiya, Rishi Popat / Unsplash. Some scenes are AI visualisation. Educational content.
